image_description: A close-up, low-light shot of three individuals wearing elaborate wigs in what appears to be a party or club setting. The foreground features a person with a large, voluminous black bouffant wig. In the mid-ground, a man wears a curly brown afro-style wig and a suit. To the right, a person is seen in profile wearing a bright orange/red wig. The lighting is warm and yellowish, creating strong shadows and highlights on the hair textures.

The texture of the black wig is somewhat 'smudged' or painterly in the shadowed areas, lacking individual strand definition. This could be due to image compression/noise reduction or slight AI smoothing, but it does not break the structure.
